subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**continues**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "As technology ________ to evolve" is a present-time statement indicating an ongoing action.
 
• The subject "technology" is singular, so the correct present tense verb is "continues."
 
• “Continues” fits both the grammatical structure and meaning, highlighting that evolution is still happening.
 
• Other options like "continue" (base form), "continuing" (participle), and "continued" (past tense) do not fit in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The evolution of technology has (1) **led__** to unprecedented advancements in various fields, from medicine to communication. The invention of the Internet, in particular, (2) **__catalysed__** a global revolution, altering how people connect and share information. Innovations in artificial intelligence and machine learning (3) **__promoted__** automation and efficiency, transforming industries and creating new economic paradigms. As technology (4) **__continues__** to evolve, ethical and social implications (5) **_________****significant consideration.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Continuing – Present participle; would require a helping verb to function correctly in the sentence.
 
• Continue – Base verb form; doesn't fit after a singular noun like "technology."
 
• Continued – Past tense; incorrect as the context is present and ongoing.
 
• Continues – Correct singular present tense verb matching "technology."
